path: four corner anchors cast outward diagonal rays; top/left/bottom/right side-center anchors cast clockwise diagonal ribbons NE/NW/SW/SE, stopping at the edge or foreground blockers
trajectory: corner rays paint red one-cell paths; side-center ribbons paint yellow paths with alternating single-cell and three-cell slices
transform: preserve the square and scattered foreground blockers; fill only original background cells
multi_step: a red ray also stops before a row-wise foreground pinch; a yellow slice is painted in side-specific order only until the first blocker, then that ribbon stops
